rationale: The original entry premise relied on ERAS consolidating tightly on its 5-minute 9-EMA ($15.34), but price has since broken down below that moving average to $15.23 across consecutive lower 1-minute closes. Furthermore, 1-minute volume has expanded during this downward drift (from ~3.4k to ~6.5k–7.3k shares per bar) while the broader market remains weak (SPY -0.64%, VIXY +3.83%), indicating short-term buyers have failed to hold the level and making an early exit prudent ahead of the $15.18 stop.
